title: Attracting new clients
functions: A showcase of services and examples of work (website/landing page)
A clear description of materials, timelines, and terms
Receiving inquiries and files (model/drawing) in one workflow
Draft replies and commercial proposals using AI
Basic SEO support and quick content updates

title: Tracking requests and inquiries
functions: All inquiries in one feed (website, email, messengers, telephony)
A single conversation card: messages, files, notes
Processing statuses and assigning an owner
Reminders: who has not been replied to for a long time and what is “stuck”
Auto-replies to common questions and handing complex ones over to an operator

title: Monitoring order fulfillment
functions: Order stages and quick statuses
Expected completion date and a “at risk” indicator
List of problematic orders by week/day
Notifications to the client and team when the status changes
A link/page showing the order status for the client

title: Working with repeat customers
functions: List of key clients (VIP/frequent orderers)
Order and agreement history without a heavy CRM
Reminders for “who hasn’t ordered in a long time”
Personalized offers and lightweight mailings
A simple overview of “who brings in more revenue/margin”
